format: links are [from, to] pairs of domain names, read as: 'from' this year directly changes 'to' next year. Every domain also affects itself (own rates, always in the support). With --fixed-map, H-P's support is exactly these links plus the four own rates: 7 entries, so H-P has (2 - 1) x (7 - 1) = 6 degrees of freedom.
